explanations.title: Bind tracker OAuth connections to the installation
explanations.summary: OAuth completion uses the verified installation and requested provider, rejects incomplete or mismatched grants, and saves the resulting connection for that installation.

explanations.title: Detect a bounded set of issue keys
explanations.summary: Issue keys found in branch names and pull-request text are normalized, deduplicated, sorted, and limited to ten results.

explanations.title: Extract acceptance criteria from descriptions
explanations.summary: Descriptions can yield up to 20 acceptance criteria from acceptance-criteria sections and checklist items, giving callers structured requirements alongside the raw text.

explanations.title: Fetch issue context from Linear or Jira
explanations.summary: Linear and Jira clients fetch issue details using the installation’s OAuth token and return a common issue shape; Jira’s structured description is flattened before criteria are extracted.

explanations.title: Bound tracker request handling
explanations.summary: Tracker requests use a ten-second default timeout and limit response processing to 2 MiB, including when discarding an error response body.

explanations.title: Store tracker connections with tenant isolation
explanations.summary: Tracker connections are stored per installation, provider, and account, with token fields for encrypted credentials; row-level security restricts access to the active installation.
